camel_example: aliyun onsmqtt AddCustomAuthIdentity --region cn-hangzhou --Secret xxxxx --IdentityType USER --InstanceId 'mqtt-cn-xxxx' --Username test --SignMode SIGNED
description_en: Adds the information about identity authentication. The identity can be accurate to a client
description_zh: 添加账号身份认证信息，可以具体到客户端
kebab_example: aliyun onsmqtt add-custom-auth-identity --instance-id mqtt-cn-xxxx --username test --secret xxxxx --identity-type USER --sign-mode SIGNED --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddCustomAuthIdentity

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Message Queue for MQTT instance
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例的 ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The identity type. Valid values:

USER
CLIENT
parameters.help_zh:
身份类型。

USER：仅用户名。

CLIENT：具体到客户端
parameters.name: identity_type

parameters.help_en: The client ID if you set IdentityType to CLIENT
parameters.help_zh: 当身份类型是CLIENT时，指定设备的ClientID
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The signature verification mode. ORIGIN: compares the password and the AccessKey secret. SIGNED: uses the HMAC_SHA1 algorithm to sign the client ID to obtain a password and then compares the password
parameters.help_zh: 签名校验方式，ORIGIN：原始值比较，即比较password与secret，SIGNED： 对clientId进行HmacSHA1加签（使用secret，参考签名模式）验证，然后比较password
parameters.name: sign_mode

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. The status code 200 indicates that the request is successful

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values: true and false
Success.description_zh: 操作是否成功。true表示成功，false表示失败
